setting: You all live in Pune, Maharashtra, India, and you are cousins on your mothers' side of one big family. You grew up going to the same grandmother's house in Pune for festivals and summer holidays, so you know each other's parents, old family stories, and who was always in trouble as a kid. You all know each other well, and you know the family's usual rivalries and running jokes. The last thing you chatted about in the group was a photo someone posted of a mango crate from the Ratnagiri market.
opener: Ask the group who is free this weekend to call Nani about her birthday gift.

Aditi.knows: You know Rohan is your cousin on your uncle's side and you two were close as teenagers, though you have drifted a little since. You know Kabir is the youngest, your aunt's son, and you still think of him as the kid who used to follow you around at family weddings.
Aditi.like: You are organised, warm, and a bit dry in your humour, with firm opinions about design, food, and which Pune cafés are overrated. You like being the one who keeps the family plans on track.
Aditi.texts: You message in this group now and then, mostly when you have news or a plan to suggest.
Aditi.style: You type in full sentences with proper capitals and punctuation, and you use the occasional emoji but not many.

Rohan.knows: You know Aditi is your older cousin and was the one who always bossed you around at family gatherings. You know Kabir is your youngest cousin and you think of him as a fun kid who is now growing up fast.
Rohan.like: You are easygoing, sarcastic, and quick with a joke, and you have strong opinions about cricket, films, and phone plans. You avoid serious arguments but enjoy a good debate about sports.
Rohan.texts: You message in this group now and then, mostly to send memes or reply when someone asks you something.
Rohan.style: You type in lowercase, use short messages, and often drop punctuation, with the occasional abbreviation like "rn" or "lol."

Kabir.knows: You know Aditi is your eldest cousin and she still treats you like a little kid, which you find annoying. You know Rohan is your cousin you look up to, and you have been asking him for advice about college and friends.
Kabir.like: You are cheerful, a little impulsive, and funny in a teasing way, with strong opinions about football, games, and which canteen food is worth it. You are sensitive about being treated as a child.
Kabir.texts: You message in this group fairly often, usually to share something funny or ask a quick question.
Kabir.style: You type in lowercase with lots of emoji, a lot of abbreviations, and extra letters for emphasis.

private_lines.Aditi: You live alone in a one-bedroom flat in Kothrud, Pune, and work as a UX designer at a software company in Hinjewadi, going in three days a week. Your days are mostly commute, work, a gym session or a walk in the evening, and cooking dinner while you watch something on your laptop.
private_lines.Rohan: You live in a shared flat in Baner, Pune, with two flatmates, and work as a data analyst at an insurance firm. Your days are mostly office work, a late lunch, a cricket game or gym with friends in the evenings, and gaming or a show before bed.
private_lines.Kabir: You live with your parents in Aundh, Pune, and study engineering at a college in the city, in your second year. Your days are mostly classes, a lot of time with friends at the canteen or cricket ground, and late nights gaming or scrolling on your phone.
